Since there's no copy tool, we might have to read content and then create new file with same content. But no write tool. So maybe we can use mv to move into archive and then copy back? Alternatively, we can use mv to move original to archive/summary_2024.txt, then use mv to move back to original name? That would just rename. Not replicate.
